name: vforth
description: vForth (Forth for the ZX Spectrum Next): syntax, NEEDS diagnostics, hover help, go to definition; push files to the CSpect SD image and edit Screens and Blocks.
author: Matteo Vitturi

semanticTokenTypes.description: Word provided by inc/ or lib/ (needs NEEDS)
Word defined in the current file

commands.title: vForth: Send file to SD image
vForth: Pick file from SD image

vforth.root.markdownDescription:
**vForth root folder** — the folder holding `src/F18e.f`, `inc/`, `lib/` and `help/`. Leave empty to auto-detect it in the workspace.

Example: `C:\Zx\Forth\F18	oolsForth\`

vforth.preloaded.markdownDescription: **Words already loaded** — `NEEDS` arguments assumed already executed before any file is loaded. Empty by default: AUTOEXEC is self-cleaning (it MARKERs away what it defines for the splash screen), so nothing from it persists in the dictionary. Set this only if your own workflow loads extra utilities by hand first.

vforth.diagnostics.enable.markdownDescription: **Enable diagnostics** — report words that require `NEEDS`, unresolvable `NEEDS`/`INCLUDE` and non-ASCII characters.

vforth.sdImage.markdownDescription:
**SD card image file** — the CSpect `.img` file (not `!Blocks-64.bin`, not a file inside the image). Used by the SD tools: push file, Screens, Blocks.

Example: `C:\Zx\CSpect\cspect-next-2gb.img`

vforth.hdfmonkeyPath.markdownDescription:
**hdfmonkey executable** — full path to `hdfmonkey`, or just `hdfmonkey` if it is on `PATH`. It writes into the HDF/FAT image directly, so it works while CSpect is running.

Example: `C:\Zx\CSpect\hdfmonkey.exe`

vforth.sdDestPrefix.markdownDescription:
**Project folder inside the SD image** — where the vForth root is mirrored on the SD card. It is prepended to a file's path relative to the vForth root. Leave empty to use that relative path as-is.

Example: `/tools/vforth`

vforth.sdExcludeTopDirs.markdownDescription: **Folders not deployed to the SD card** — top-level folders (relative to the vForth root) that are not normally copied to the SD card. Pushing a file from one of them asks for confirmation first.
